text:
Alex W: Hey folks — landing my first PR from feature/stripe-checkout. Quick checklist so I don't mess up the repo norms: which lint/precommit hooks should run locally, preferred branch naming, and who do I ping for a quick review?
Maya P: congrats! :tada: for local checks run `npm ci && npm run lint && npm test` (or `./gradlew check` for infra services). we have pre-commit hooks via husky, but run the lint manually if you changed JS/TS.
Ben T: branch prefix guide: `feat/` for new features, `fix/` for bug fixes, `infra/` for infra/deploy stuff, `chore/` for chore. keep names short: feat/checkout-add-payment-intent.
Zoe R: reviewers: start with the module owners in CODEOWNERS. if it's infra/runtime related ping me @Zoe and @Ben. Otherwise @Maya for API/SDK changes. if in doubt add `@devex` in your PR body.
Alex W: thanks — is there a PR template I should use? and do we squash or rebase on merge?
Maya P: PR template is in `.github/pull_request_template.md`. include: short summary, migration or rollback notes (if any), perf impact, and a small test plan. Example checklist snippet you can paste:```- Summary
- Tests added/updated
- Lint/format passed
- Migration notes (if any)```
Ben T: merging policy: for small fixes use rebase-and-merge, for feature work we prefer squash-and-merge unless the review requests keep the commit history. Put `SQUASH` in the PR title if you want it squashed.
Zoe R: also add the `area:` label (e.g., `area: api`, `area: infra`) — automations rely on that.
Alex W: local env question: I keep hitting an auth error when running `npm test` — says missing REDWOOD_TEST_KEY. is there a secrets doc?
Maya P: add `~/.redwood/env` from the onboarding vault (link in #help). if you're missing access ping @people-ops — they grant vault viewer. devex-bot can also tell you where to request access.
devex-bot: For vault access requests, open an IT ticket at https://redwood.okta/vault-request and include your manager's name.
Ben T: small tip — run `tools/prep_pr.sh` before pushing. It runs format, lint-fix, and a quick smoke test. saves a lot of back-and-forth.
Alex W: awesome, thanks! last one: commit message format?
Maya P: follow Conventional Commits: `feat(scope): short description` or `fix(scope): description`. For example: `feat(checkout): add payment intent retry`. Include the issue number in the body if there is one.
Alex W: perfect. I'll run the prep script and flag @Zoe for review when it's up. thanks all :raised_hands:
Zoe R: happy to review — ping once CI passes and include the PR link here.
